card.name: Linking words before immunosuppressant drug names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as with, of, a or after that come right before a named immunosuppressant or combination-therapy drug. It is strongest before mycophenolate, mycophenolic acid or MMF.

modes.label: With before mycophenolate
modes.description: The word with after treated or co-administered, just before mycophenolic acid or mycophenolate mofetil.
modes.example: have been reported in patients treated<< with>> mycophenolic acid.

modes.label: Linking word in combination regimens
modes.description: A small word or drug-name piece in a combination regimen, before another named drug.
modes.example: in combination with<< a>> rituximab product, cyclo

modes.label: Use of or other before drug
modes.description: Of, other or using before a drug class or drug name.
modes.example: has been reported with the use<< of>> mycophenolate products, and
